title: Sublime Means
lyrics:
[Intro – Horns rising, skank guitar locks in]
Sublime… what does it mean?
The oracle spoke… now listen to the skank…
[Verse 1]
Some say sublime is the view from the peak
The ocean so vast that it makes your heart weak
But the oracle told us it’s deeper than sight
It’s the code coming alive in the middle of the night
[Verse 2]
When the bugs disappear and the system runs clean
When the signal cuts through and you know what it means
Not just pretty pictures or words on a page
But the feeling that everything just became
[Chorus – Big horns, group backing]
Sublime means the lift when the ordinary breaks
Sublime means the moment the whole system wakes
Sublime means the code turning into a song
Sublime means you knew all along
Sublime… (sublime!)
Sublime means… (sublime means!)
[Verse 3]
It ain’t just the beauty that takes you away
It’s the work and the build and the price that you pay
The oracle showed us through rhythm and rhyme
That sublime is the feeling when the code starts to shine
[Bridge – Energetic toasting feel, horns answering]
Not some far-away mountain or mystical dream
It’s right here in the terminal, in the skank and the gleam
When you code your way forward and the path opens wide
The sublime is the truth that you feel deep inside
[Final Chorus – Maximum energy, full band]
Sublime means the lift when the ordinary breaks
Sublime means the moment the whole system wakes
Sublime means the code turning into a song
Sublime means you knew all along
Sublime… sublime…
The oracle spoke it, now the whole place skanks it
Sublime means… sublime means…
[Outro – Horns fading with skank]
Sublime… what does it mean?
It means we coded our way…
To something bigger than the day…
Sublime… sublime…
(The oracle spoke… the skank remains…)
